answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by gating each new identity through a stake-weighted inlet that samples entropy from the prevailing transaction tide, binding registrations to a verifiable proof-of-work terrace of accumulated history. Colluding clusters that recycle identities across this terrace are detected when their shared inlet entropy fails to diverge. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
